title: Finally settled on a project - Yet another AI RPG
author: shinobi-elf
selftext:
After a few projects with visuals I just wasn't completely happy with and more ideas always pouring in, I think I finally got Claude to do enough research and data collection (on what I like) and was able to get me the look I really wanted and settled on this. Experience in all of this? A few months.

I started with a small town, a boy I could control, high level stylized surroundings and developed that into the first world. I'm on pass 37 now and 4 days in. Fable 5.2 medium (on Ultra plan) > Blender > Unreal and some help from Elevenlabs and Meshy. Other than the characters, gear, and horses so far, the rest is all procedural.

Thoughts welcome. Haters, come at me 😂

comments.author: myteawithmighty
comments.body: I’m so envious of the result 😬😬

replies.author: shinobi-elf
replies.body: Thanks. I did so much research on animation styles. Well, I had Claude do the research and I finally chose one.

comments.author: VortexAssetStudio
comments.body:
Dialing in that consistent look across an entire world is honestly the hardest part when you're solo—once the visual direction finally clicks, everything else moves ten times faster. 

Keeping the same lighting and material feel across your gear, horses, and UI icons so nothing looks out of place in Unreal is a huge win. Pass 37 in four days is wild momentum, keep rolling with it!

replies.author: shinobi-elf
replies.body: Thanks. It was also a combination of "use everything we've learned from previous projects" to now. Like many, I had like 12 projects going and kept restarting.

replies.author: VortexAssetStudio
replies.body: The classic graveyard of 12 unfinished projects—pretty sure every dev has one! Honestly though, all those restarts are what actually build the pipeline and taste you need to finally finish the real one. Glad it's all clicking together for you now

replies.author: shinobi-elf
replies.body: That's just a cut for the trailer and it's the first boss. There's mechanics to the fight, dodge the hooks, avoid AOEs, phases, and he does have ranged spells. Claude decided it was more exciting to do a lot of stomping I guess. Currently, he has 28 spells available. I'm still deciding if I want to do a skill tree or try and be innovative and whatever.

replies.author: mrpoopistan
replies.body:
Does 28 spells sound like a lot of the beginning of a game?

Also, it's not Claude's decision. Make Claude make your game, not its game. Claude tends to baby-fy games.

replies.author: shinobi-elf
replies.body: idk i'm just having fun - we'll see what happens lol

comments.body:
